iphone.edgeSwipes: PhoneEdgeSwipes (Matt, 2026-11-12): left edge moves one screen left (Ask → Notes → Plan → Read → Library), right edge one screen right; search outside the chain. The screen follows the finger in pictures only, the live screens never moved (going left, the leaving screen is carried off over the arriving one, which drifts in from a third across; going right, the arriving one comes in over the leaving one, which drifts beneath); the tab bar stays and its selection changes as the swipe begins. Settles past half the width or on a 300 pt/s flick (spring 0.35 s, no bounce), else springs back. Reduce Motion: a cut once 60 pt in. Starts only in the 24 pt edge zone, before scrolls and row swipe actions; never under a sheet, with text selected, or from the left edge of a pushed screen (the back swipe's). The keyboard goes down as Ask is left. At the chain's ends (Ask's right edge, Library's left) the edge holds the drag and nothing moves; the glass bar buttons are not in the pictures
iphone.noteSheet: PhoneNoteSheet (Matt chose option A, 2026-11-12): a tap on a highlight with a note (pen off), a note's margin mark or a Notes in This Chapter row opens it to read on paper.page: Close (xmark), the reference as title, Edit; the quote on its color; the note rendered with references as accent links (NoteBodyText, ReferenceLinker note rules). A reference pushes its verses in the sheet (Back, Open in Read). Foot: bottom bar of color chip (menu of colors and No Color, current checked), bookmark, Ask, delete (closes, undoable), ellipsis (Copy, Copy with Reference, Share); a chapter note has delete alone. Edit shows the editor with Done (back to reading); Add Note, Edit Note and an empty note open in the editor. A highlight without a note keeps the edit bar. While a note is read and has more than one version, its mark is a button of at least 44 pt under the text that pushes a Versions page (the versions view; choices at least 44 pt tall; a choice that settles the last version pops the page)
iphone.progressLine: the Mac's ReadingProgressLine (accent, 2 pt, ReadingProgress's rule) under the title and translation in the top bar's principal item; width a @ScaledMetric tied to the headline; no animation; VoiceOver reads it apart from the title as 'Chapter progress'
iphone.verseTap: a tap on a verse's words or number (pen off) selects that verse's text (VerseSpan.textRange, no number) with the system's handles and presents the selection menu at once, never waiting for a second tap; with a selection up (a tapped verse, a dragged range, a held word, an opened highlight) a tap anywhere off it only clears it and closes the menu, selecting and opening nothing, and the next tap acts as with nothing selected (Matt, 2026-11-17, overturning 'a tap on another verse moves it'); a tap on the selection keeps it and shows its menu again; one rule, isTapAway, read as the touch came down, answers for the verse tap, the highlight tap and the repeated tap; with nothing selected a highlight keeps its old behaviour; with the chapter cards open the tap closes them and selects nothing; a tap that stops a moving scroll, in the thumb's zone or on a margin mark is not a verse tap; with VoiceOver running nothing changes; a second tap the system does not take as a double tap leaves the verse selected with its menu (settleRepeatedTap); the double tap narrows to the word
iphone.selectionFill: the system's own selection (handles, loupe, menu, VoiceOver, selectedRange); only the fill's shape is the app's: ReaderSelectionHighlightView, set as the text view's UITextSelectionDisplayInteraction.highlightView (public API, iOS 17+), takes the system's line rects (full line height, joined) and paints each cut to that line's words by segmentFrames, the highlights' own segments, square cornered, as one shape, in the tint the system gives it (the system's selection colour); a line with no words is not filled; never after a line's last word, in an indent or across the margins. The system gives rects only for the lines in or near view, and only the layout fragments under them are walked, so a handle drag on a whole chapter's selection costs what one screen does; a selection never carries into other text (another chapter, translation or book clears it; the screen is told on the next main-queue turn, after the SwiftUI update, and an outline a jump set is kept), while the same chapter laid out again keeps it on the same words (a text size keeps its range; a page style that moves the verses' offsets, Lectern, carries it by verse and offset as highlights are)
iphone.selectionMenu: system edit menu, placed against the whole selection's bounds (the part in view between the bars): directly above its first line when there is room under the top bar, else directly below its last line, never over a selected word; with room on neither side, above the visible part at the page's top edge over the bar (menuPlacement; the text view's own menu after a held word or a handle drag is the system's placement, also above or below): one color chip first (a filled circle, no title, in the highlight's color inside one, else the pen's; drawn for the text view's appearance), a submenu the system lists vertically with every color by circle and name, then No Color where offered, the current one checked; then the Mac's actions in the phone's own order (Note, Delete inside a highlight, bookmark, Ask, Compare Translations, Cross-References, Copy, Copy with Reference, Copy Link, Share; the Mac keeps its order), each drawn in the bar as its symbol alone (the Mac's symbols; Delete's trash in the destructive red; the title empty, carried as subtitle and accessibility label so VoiceOver and the chevron's list name it), then the system's titled Look Up and Translate; on iOS 27 the system may add one item of its own (Ask Siri) at the bar's end, after all of these, which the app cannot remove. Wide phone (the iPhone 18 Pro Max in the simulator), default size: seven symbols before the chevron over plain words, the chip, Note, Bookmark, Ask, Compare Translations and Cross-References, with Copy as the seventh (Matt asked for the panels in the bar in place of Copy and Copy with Reference, 2026-11-18), with Copy with Reference, Copy Link and Share behind the chevron; inside a highlight: chip, Note, Delete, Bookmark, Ask, Compare Translations, Cross-References, Copy as the seventh, then the same tail (not looked at with the panels); a narrower phone fits fewer, and the system's own iOS 27 item shares the bar; neither was seen with the panels; both panel items are dimmed, not hidden, while the screen has not wired them; largest accessibility size: chip and two actions. The chevron lists the whole menu, every row named. VoiceOver: 'Highlight color', value the color's name. The pen's menu under a mark leads with the same chip in the mark's color, then note, bookmark, Ask and Delete as symbols; a choice recolors the mark and becomes the pen's color
